metadata.name: Crossroads
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A downtown block where an avenue crosses a street. Embers come up from the south past a corner shop and a sandbagged bunker; Tide hold the north. Bomb site A is the gas station under its canopy, B the warehouse floor; in Hostage Rescue the hostages wait upstairs in the house and on the warehouse mezzanine. Parked cars, bus stops and barriers are the cover on the open streets, and a fire escape climbs to the warehouse’s upper door.
